standard_ads_revenue_milestones.public_watch_hours_note: Not calculated from estimatedMinutesWatched: this API metric includes content that may not qualify. Verify eligible public watch hours in YouTube Studio > Earn.

expanded_ypp_reference.note: Country availability and all other YPP requirements apply; verify in Studio > Earn.

limitations: Shorts video views are a proxy from videos in output/uploaded_videos.json, not verified eligible public Shorts Feed views.
The Shorts proxy may include views outside the Shorts Feed and can be incomplete if upload history is incomplete.
Estimated channel watch hours are not the same as eligible public watch hours.
YouTube Studio > Earn is the authoritative source for monetization eligibility.
